candidates.tagline: China's biggest AI conference: 300 product debuts, one pony ride
candidates.story: At China's World AI Conference (WAIC 2026) in Shanghai — where 300+ AI products debuted promising to transform civilization — the viral moment was a smiling conference-goer riding a quadruped robot like a fairground pony through the exhibition hall.
candidates.why_funny: Every CEO pitched world-changing AI robotics; the actual crowd-pleaser at the world's biggest AI expo was giving people pony rides.
candidates.alt: A woman sits and rides a sleek silver and black quadruped robot through a tech conference exhibition hall as a large crowd surrounds her, laughing and taking photos

candidates.tagline: AI Love Irondale Day: the revolution is a man in a robot suit
candidates.story: Irondale, Alabama rebranded its community festival as 'AI Love Irondale Day' to attract tech investment, faced an immediate online backlash calling it 'a pep rally for data centers,' and the mayor reversed course within days — but the festival's AI robot turned out to be a performer in an enormous LED-lit costume dancing in a parking lot.
candidates.why_funny: The town promised an AI-powered future and delivered a dude in a very large plastic robot suit doing the Achy Breaky Heart in Spanish.
candidates.alt: A huge LED-covered robot costume performer dances at an outdoor community festival with 'Irondale' visible on a sign in the background and a crowd of families watching
